text: 1 1 The Vanished Him 狂少归来
1 INT. HOSPITAL - DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

1 内景医院-医生办公室-白天 1 VINCENT is slumped in a wheelchair, unconscious. JESSICA looks on with concern as the DOCTOR examines Vincent. The doctor puts down his stethoscope and SIGHS. 文森特瘫坐在轮椅上，昏迷不醒。杰西卡关切地看着医生检查文森特。医生放下听 诊器，叹气。
医生 I'm sorry. It may be time to let him go. His chances of recovery are slim. 对不起。也许是时候让他走了。他康复的可能性 很小。
杰西卡 （严肃地） Doctor, as long as there’s a chance, I won’t give up. 医生，只要有机会，我就不会放弃。
The doctor looks at Jessica and Vincent, shaking his head and SIGHING. 医生看着杰西卡和文森特，摇头叹气。

医生 I saw everything you've done over the years. It's truly touching. If you still don’t want to give up, there is a new medication that might help you, but it’s quite expensive. 我看到了你这些年来所做的一切。它真的很感 人。如果你仍然不想放弃，有一种新药可能会对 你有所帮助，但它相当昂贵。 Jessica's eyes brighten. 杰西卡的眼睛亮了起来。
杰西卡 No matter how much it costs, I'll find a way to raise the money. 不管花多少钱，我都会想办法筹集资金。
3 3 医生 It's $100k per injection! 每次注射10万美元！ Jessie is stunned, but soon calms down. 杰西惊呆了，但很快就平静下来了。
杰西卡 Please! Just give me a little more time, just a little bit more, and I'll come up with the money. 拜托！再给我一点时间，再多一点，我会筹到钱 的。
医生 Where are you going to get that much money? The nurse told me you're planning to sell a kidney! 你打算从哪里弄到这么多钱？护士告诉我你打算 卖肾！
杰西卡 I would do anything until Vincent gets up, but we’re not giving up on the treatment. 在文森特醒来之前，我什么都愿意做，但我们不会放弃治疗。
The doctor takes an envelope from his white coat and hands it to Jessica. 医生从白色外套里拿出一个信封递给杰西卡。
医生 Here’s 20 thousand dollars. The doctors put this together for you and Vincent. Take this for now. 这是两万美元。医生为你和文森特准备了这个。 暂时拿着这个。
杰西卡 （感动得流泪） Thank you so, so much! I’m truly, deeply grateful! I promise I will pay you back in the future. 非常感谢！我真的非常感激！我保证将来会还你 的。
医生 No need for that. You’ve shown us that true compassion still exists in this world. We’re happy to help you. 无需如此。你已经向我们表明，真正的同情仍然 存在于这个世界上。我们很乐意帮助您。
The Doctor leaves, and Jessica crouches down gently looking at Vincent, holding his hand. 医生走了，杰西卡蹲下来，轻轻地看着文森特，握着他的手。
杰西卡 Vincent, did you hear that? So many people care about us. I will never give up on you, so please don’t give up on yourself, okay? 文森特，你听到了吗？这么多人关心我们。我永 远不会放弃你，所以请不要放弃自己，好吗？
Jessica doesn't notice that Vincent's fingers twitch slightly. 杰西卡没有注意到文森特的手指微微抽搐。
EXT. WILSON BUILDING - DAY

2 外景-威尔逊大厦-白天 2 At the entrance of the Wilson Building, two rows of BODYGUARDS stand neatly at the doors. A luxury car pulls up. WENDY (50, Vincent's mother), dressed in a professional suit, steps out. Nearby, a group of REPORTERS spots her and rushes over, but the bodyguards immediately hold them back. 在威尔逊大厦的入口处，两排BODYGUARDS整齐地站在门口。一辆豪华轿车停了下 来。温迪（50岁，文森特的母亲）穿着职业套装走了出来。在附近，一群记者发现 了她并冲了过去，但保镖立即阻止了他们。
记者

Mrs. Wendy Wilson, Wilson Group is the largest conglomerate in the U.S., but the CEO position has remained vacant. Are there rumors that you wish to find your son to take over the position? 温迪·威尔逊女士，威尔逊集团是美国最大的企业 集团，但首席执行官职位一直空缺。有传言说你 想让你儿子接任这个职位吗？ Wendy stops and turns to face the reporters.

5 5 温迪停下脚步，转身面对记者。WENDY 温迪 That's right. My son, Vincent, has been missing for three years, and I have been searching for him. The entire Wilson Group is waiting for his return. 没错。我的儿子文森特已经失踪三年了，我一直 在找他。整个威尔逊集团都在等待他的归来。 Wendy turns and enters the building, but the reporters try to ask more questions, only to be firmly blocked by the bodyguards. 温迪转身走进大楼，但记者们试图问更多的问题，却被保镖们牢牢地挡住了。
3 INT. WILSON GROUP - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY
3 内景威尔逊集团-会议室-白天 Wendy strides into the office at a sharp pace. The 6 SHAREHOLDERS stand up as she enters. 温迪快步走进办公室。她进来时，6名股东站了起来。
股东 Good morning， Mrs. Wilson. 早上好，威尔逊夫人。
温迪 Newman, for the past three years you’ve been responsible for finding Vincent. Where is he? 纽曼，在过去的三年里，你一直负责寻找文森 特。他在哪里？
NEWMAN lowers his head, unable to meet Wendy’s gaze. 纽曼低下头，无法直视温迪的目光。
纽曼
The last place Vincent was seen three years ago was Dream Shadow Town. 三年前，文森特最后一次被看到的地方是梦幻阴 影镇。 Since then, we have no further leads. 从那以后，我们没有进一步的线索。
温迪
6 6 Find him even if you have to turn the entire town upside down! 即使你必须把整个城镇翻个底朝天，也要找到 他！
纽曼 Yes, Ma’am! 是的，女士！

温迪 Whoever finds my son will get the full endorsement by the wealth of the Wilson Consortium and the power of my husband's gang.But if this act of loyalty turns out to be a betrayal, don’t blame me for being ruthless and unforgiving. 无论谁找到我的儿子，都将得到威尔逊财团财富 和我丈夫帮派力量的全力支持。但如果这种忠诚 行为被证明是背叛，不要责怪我无情和不宽容。
The crowd is very excited. 人群非常兴奋。
人群 We’ll do our best to find him. 我们会尽力找到他的。
4 EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY

4 外景 路边- 白天 4 Jessica is selling hot dogs and burgers on the roadside, with unconscious Vincent sitting in a wheelchair beside her. 杰西卡在路边卖热狗和汉堡，昏迷的文森特坐在她旁边的轮椅上。 Jessica notices Vincent's head is tilting, and gently adjusts it and kisses his cheek softly. 杰西卡注意到文森特的头在倾斜，轻轻地调整了一下，轻轻地吻了吻他的脸颊。
客户 Could you get me a burger, please? 你能给我拿个汉堡吗？
杰西卡 Of course, right away.
7 7 当然，马上。 Jessica busily prepares the hamburger and hands it to the
杰西卡忙着准备汉堡，递给女顾客。
客户 （温柔地看着杰西卡） I know you. You have cared for your boyfriend for three years without ever leaving his side. And The whole town knows that. 我认识你。你照顾你男朋友三年了，从来没有离 开过他。全城的人都知道这一点。
Jessica takes a gentle look at Vincent. 杰西卡温柔地看了文森特一眼。
杰西卡
Vincent is my boyfriend, how could I possibly stand by and do nothing while he's sick? I have to try my best. 文森特是我的男朋友，我怎么可能在他生病的时 候袖手旁观呢？我必须尽力。
客户 You are such a nice girl. There aren't many people like you anymore. I hope he recovers soon. 你真是个好女孩。像你这样的人已经不多了。我 希望他早日康复。

The customer hands Jessica a $100 bill. She looks down, rummaging through the cash box to find the change. When she looks up, change in hand, the customer is already gone. 顾客递给杰西卡一张100美元的钞票。她低下头，在钱箱里翻找零钱。当她抬头看 时，手里拿着零钱，顾客已经走了。
杰西卡 Your change! 你的改变！
客户 Keep it. We’re just doing our part to help.
8 8 保留它。我们只是尽我们的一份力量来帮助你。 Jessica's eyes fill with gratitude. 杰西卡的眼睛充满了感激之情。
杰西卡 Thank you. 非常感谢。
5 EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY - CONTINUOUS
5 外景路边——白天 5 As the customer leaves, Jessica walks over to Vincent and adjusts the blanket that is draped over his legs. 当顾客离开时，杰西卡走到文森特面前，整理着他腿上的毯子。

杰西卡 Vincent, there are still kind people in the world. Once we save enough money and use the new medication, you’ll get better. 文森特，世界上还有善良的人。一旦我们存够了 钱并使用新药，你就会好起来的。 Just then, BEN (25, Jessica's younger brother) approaches. 就在这时，本（25岁，杰西卡的弟弟）走近。
本 Sis, I knew you’d be here. 姐姐，我就知道你会在这里。
杰西卡 What brings you here? 你为什么来这里？
本 You work three jobs for Vincent every day, suffering so much. When will it end? 你每天为文森特做三份工作，受了这么多苦。什 么时候结束？
9 9 杰西卡 Ben, if you came to persuade me to give up, then please leave. 本，如果你是来劝我放弃的，那么请离开。

本 （认真） Jessica, you already received an offer from MIT with a bright future ahead. And yet, you abandoned that to sell hot dogs for a comatose person. Is this really worth it? 杰西卡，你已经收到了麻省理工学院的录取通知 书，前途光明。然而，你却放弃了这些，为昏迷 的人卖热狗。这真的值得吗？
杰西卡 I don’t need your advice; I heard the same thing from Dad three years ago. 我不需要你的建议；三年前，我从爸爸那里听到 了同样的话。
本 How can you still bring up Dad? For the past three years, you haven’t even called home. Are you really the daughter that Mom and Dad raised? 你怎么还提你的爸爸？在过去的三年里，你甚至 没有给家里打过电话。你真的是爸爸妈妈养大的 女儿吗？

杰西卡 （哽咽） I know I’ve let Mom and Dad down; I haven’t become their pride. I can understand why Dad wants to sever ties, but I really can’t give up on Vincent. 我知道我让爸爸妈妈失望了；我没有成为他们的 骄傲。我能理解爸爸为什么想断绝关系，但我真 的不能放弃文森特。
（更多）
杰西卡（续）
10 10 He's an orphan, and I'm the only person in this world who truly loves him. You have Mom and Dad, but Vincent? He only has me. 他是个孤儿，我是这个世界上唯一真正爱他的 人。你有爸爸妈妈，但文森特呢？他只有我。
本

He claims to be an orphan, and you just believe him? You’ve sacrificed so much for this unknown person. Even if you give up now, everyone will understand. 他声称自己是个孤儿，而你却相信他？你为这个 不知名的人牺牲了这么多。即使你现在放弃，每 个人都会理解的。

杰西卡 Ben, stop it. I won’t give up! I have to cure him. Just go away! 本，住手。我不会放弃的！我必须治好他。走 开！ Ben SIGHS deeply and pulls out a bank card from his pocket, offering it to Jessica.Jessica looks surprised. 本深深地叹气，从口袋里掏出一张银行卡，递给杰西卡。杰西卡看起来很惊讶。
本 Take this.拿着这个。
6 EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY
6 外景路边——白天 6 What is this? 这是什么？ Ben hands the card over to Jessica. 本把卡片递给杰西卡。
本 This card has a total of $500k. I saved $100k from my job, and the rest is from Dad selling the house... 这张卡总共有50万美元。我从工作中节省了10万
11 11 美元，剩下的都是爸爸卖房子赚来的。。。
杰西卡 （惊讶） Dad sold the house? Didn’t he cut ties with me? 爸爸把房子卖了？他不是和我断绝关系了吗？

本 That was just Dad acting out of anger. Did you really take him seriously? Ever since you left home, most of the money I've sent you every month has been from Mom and Dad. They couldn’t bear to face you, so they’ve been helping through me. 那只是爸爸生气的表现。你真的把他当回事吗？ 自从你离开家后，我每个月寄给你的大部分钱都 是爸爸妈妈寄来的。他们不忍心面对你，所以他 们一直在帮我。
12 12 Tears well up in Jessica’s eyes. 杰西卡眼里含着泪水。
杰西卡 Where do they live now? 他们现在住在哪里？
本
They rented a cheap place in the suburbs. I’ll send you the address. 他们在郊区租了一个便宜的地方。我会把地址发 给你。
杰西卡 And what about you? You gave me all your savings. 你呢？你把所有的积蓄都给了我。
本 Don’t worry about me. You’re my only sister, and Vincent is my future brother-in-law. We’re family, and that’s all that matters. 别担心我。你是我唯一的妹妹，文森特是我未来 的姐夫。我们是一家人，这才是最重要的。

Jessica is overcome with emotion. 杰西卡情绪激动。 BEN (cont'd) 本（续） You haven’t seen Mom and Dad in years. Dad has aged a lot. Today is his 60th birthday, and I have to go to Miami for a business trip. You should celebrate his birthday with him; take Vincent along. 你已经很多年没见到爸爸妈妈了。爸爸老了很 多。今天是他的60岁生日，我得去迈阿密出差。 你应该和他一起庆祝他的生日；带上文森特。 Jessica nods. 杰西卡点点头。
13 13 杰西卡 I will. I’ll go now. 我会的。我现在就走。
7 INT. SUBURBAN SHABBY HOUSE - DAY

7 内景郊区破旧的房子-白天 7 EDWIN (60, Jessica's father) is tinkering with a toolbox, while JANE (55, Jessica's mother) sets a plate of spaghetti on the table beside him. 埃德温（60岁，杰西卡的父亲）正在摆弄工具箱，而简（55岁，杰西卡母亲）在 他旁边的桌子上放了一盘意大利面。
简 Stop fiddling with your toolbox and eat. 别再摆弄工具箱了，赶紧吃吧。
埃德温 I just need to check the toolbox before heading out to work. 上班前我只需要检查一下工具箱。
简 It’s your 60th birthday today, Edwin. You should stay home. 今天是你60岁生日，埃德温。你应该待在家里。 Edwin closes the toolbox and places it aside carefully.
JESSICA rolls VINCENT into the house, and upon seeing her mom and dad, she immediately tears up. 埃德温合上工具箱，小心地放在一边。杰西卡把文森特推进屋，一看到爸爸妈妈， 她立刻哭了。
埃德温 I make 200 bucks a day out there; I need to save that money for Jessica. 我在那里每天赚200美元；我需要为杰西卡省下那 笔钱。
简 But your leg was still hurting last
14 14 night. 但你的腿昨晚还是疼。 Seeing her distress, Edwin joins her at the table and starts eating the spaghetti. 看到她的痛苦，埃德温加入了她的行列，开始吃意大利面条。

埃德温 It’s fine. We sold the house; we have no other assets left. Jessica’s money won’t last long—I need to help her. 没事的。我们卖掉了房子；我们没有其他资产 了。杰西卡的钱用不了多久，我需要帮助她。 Jessica, in tears, pushes Vincent closer and stands before her parents. 杰西卡流着泪，把文森特推得更近，站在父母面前。
杰西卡 Dad, Mom... （声音颤抖）爸爸，妈 妈。。。 Upon seeing Jessica, Edwin drops his fork in surprise. 见到杰西卡，埃德温惊讶地放下叉子。
埃德温 So, you’ve finally decided to come back home? 所以，你终于决定回家了？
Jessica stands anxiously in place. 杰西卡紧张地站在原地。

杰西卡 Happy birthday, Dad. 生日快乐，爸爸。 As she speaks, she pulls a apple pie from her bag and places it in front of her father. 她一边说，一边从包里拿出一个苹果派，放在爸爸面前。 JESSICA (cont'd) Dad, this is your favorite pie. I prepared it myself. I’m sorry I
15 15 couldn’t prepare a cake for you. 杰西卡（续）爸爸，这是你 最喜欢的馅饼。我自己准备的。很抱歉，我 无法为你准备蛋糕。 Edwin scoffs, while Jane looks at Vincent, feeling awkward, then glances at Jessica. 埃德温嘲笑道，而简则尴尬地看着文森特，然后瞥了杰西卡一眼。
简 What are you doing? This is homemade by Jessica. Light some candles, and it’s a cake too. 你在做什么？这是杰西卡自制的。点燃一些蜡烛， 这也是一个蛋糕。

埃德温 Am I angry because there’s no cake? It’s been three years; you’ve been suffering alone and didn’t keep in touch. We’ve been worried sick about you. 我生气是因为没有蛋糕吗？已经三年了；你一直 在独自受苦，没有保持联系。我们一直很担心 你。 Edwin picks up the apple pie and starts eating it. As he eats, he begins to cry. Jessica and Jane rush to comfort him. 埃德温拿起苹果派开始吃。吃的时候，他开始哭了。杰西卡和简赶紧安慰他。
杰西卡 I’m sorry, Dad. It’s my fault; it’s all my fault. 对不起，爸爸。这是我的错；都是我的错。 Edwin holds Jessica tight. 埃德温紧紧地抱住杰西卡。
埃德温 （哽咽） No, it’s my fault. I shouldn’t have tried to stop you two from being together back then. 不，这是我的错。当时我不应该阻止你们俩在一 起。 Edwin glances at unconscious Vincent.
16 16 埃德温瞥了一眼昏迷的文森特。
简 (overjoyed and tearful) （喜极而泣） It’s just good to have you back. A family should always be together. 很高兴你回来了。一个家庭应该永远在一起。
The three of them embrace. Just then, a voice interrupts. 他们三人拥抱。就在这时，一个声音打断了。
潘西 What a shabby place. It smells like poverty. 多么破旧的地方啊。闻起来像贫穷。

They turn to see PANSY (55, a woman) accompanied by MAY (27, a young woman), both dressed in designer clothes, carrying designer bags, and looking disdainful. 他们转身看到潘西（55岁，女性）和梅（27岁，年轻女性），两人都穿着名牌衣 服，背着名牌包，看起来很轻蔑。
8 INT. SUBURBAN SHABBY HOUSE - DAY
8 内景 郊区破旧的房子 白天 8 Pansy fans her hand in front of her face, and Jane, seeing her, happily approaches. 潘西把她的手放在脸前，简看到她，高兴地走近。
简 Pansy, May, what brings you here? 潘西，梅，你为什么来这里？
梅 Isn't it Uncle's Edwin's birthday today? What’s the matter? We're not welcome? 今天不是埃德温叔叔的生日吗？怎么了？不欢迎 吗？
17 17 简 It’s not that we’re unwelcoming, it’s just... 不是我们不欢迎，只是。。。
埃德温 It’s just that after so many years without contact, why today... 只是这么多年没有联系，为什么今天。。。
简 （打断） Let’s not get into that. Since you’re here, please, have a seat. 我们不要谈这个了。既然你来了，请坐。 Pansy glances at the Apple pie on the table. 潘茜瞥了一眼桌上的苹果派。
潘西 What is this? Is this how you treat us? 这是什么？你就这样对待我们吗？ May joins in, looking equally disdainful. 梅也加入了进来，看起来同样轻蔑。
可以 Uncle, for your 60th birthday, you’re serving this? How embarrassing. You can’t even afford a cake. 叔叔，在您60岁生日时，你吃这个东西吗？真尴 尬。你甚至买不起蛋糕。
杰西卡 You guys are really too much. 你们真的太过分了。
潘西 （见文森特）

18 18 Too much? Did I say something wrong? Oh, look, this useless vegetable is here too. You sold your house and came to this dump for him. What are you hoping for? 太多？我说错什么了吗？哦，看，这个没用的植 物人也在这里。你卖掉了房子，来到这个垃圾场 找他。你希望什么？ Edwin quickly steps in to defend his daughter. 埃德温迅速介入为女儿辩护。
埃德温 This is a private family matter. It has nothing to do with you. 这是一个私人家庭事务。这与你无关。
杰西卡 Exactly! Vincent is not useless; please show some respect. 确切地！文森特并非一无是处；请表现出一些尊 重。

潘西 Jessica, how can you be so inconsiderate? You’re so beautiful; you could easily find someone to marry instead of this waste. Instead, you’ve dragged the whole family into the pit. 杰西卡，你怎么能这么不体谅别人？你真漂亮； 你可以很容易地找到一个结婚的人，而不是这种 浪费。相反，你把全家都拖进了坑里。
Jessica lowers her head in guilt. 杰西卡内疚地低下了头。
梅 With this vegetable around, your family can expect a lifetime of poverty. 有了这种植物人，你的家人可能会终生贫困。
